richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Jorhat

c: Around Jorhat, tea estates run their own staff lines, clubs and schools, and many of them have grounds where an outdoor gym fits well. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to tea estates, schools, colleges, government campuses and public parks in Jorhat. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 2,320 km away, and travel to upper Assam by road.

Tea garden work is long and physical, so workers and their families tend to use gentle machines for stretching and light cardio. Estate managers often add strength stations for younger staff and students. Upper Assam stays humid with a long monsoon, so the frames are galvanised and the seats roto-moulded. We plan the full order before dispatch and fit it through our team or a dealer in the north-east. Share the ground size and photos for a layout drawing.

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can a tea estate order outdoor gym equipment?
items.a: Yes. Send us the size of the ground, photos and the users you expect. We will suggest machines, send a layout drawing and quote, and install after approval.

items.q: How do you handle the distance to Jorhat?
items.a: We plan the full order before dispatch so it travels from Vasai as one shipment by road. Our own team or a dealer in the north-east then installs it.

items.q: Will the humid weather affect the machines?
items.a: Galvanised frames resist rust and roto-moulded seats do not rot. Keep water draining away from the bases and check moving parts after the monsoon.
